name: Grade 9 IT Practice: May Week 11 - Reliability
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.example: The team improved reliability by making the sensor work three times in a row.

words.definition: A note in code that explains something.
words.example: The code comment explained why the threshold was set to 400.

words.definition: A test where conditions are carefully chosen.
words.example: The controlled test used the same distance for each sensor trial.

words.definition: A result showing whether something worked or not.
words.example: The group marked each trial as pass/fail in the test table.

words.definition: The part that needs the most improvement.
words.example: The weak point was a loose wire near the breadboard.

words.definition: A tested change that makes the circuit or code more dependable.
words.example: The improvement secured the wire so the circuit stopped disconnecting.
